stage.quote: Tonic is now RunKit, a part of Stripe
stage.note: Company (as Tonic Development) went through YC S16, then was acquired by Stripe in September 2016 before any priced VC round was ever disclosed; it has operated as a Stripe product/subsidiary since. No independent funding round beyond the standard YC deal was found.

last_round.quote: Tonic is now RunKit, a part of Stripe

note: YC hint confirmed: the YC S16 'RunKit' company (site tonicdev.com, founders Francisco Tolmasky, Pieter Ouwerkerk, Wolf Rentzsch) is the same company as runkit.com — it was originally named Tonic and was renamed RunKit upon being acquired by Stripe in September 2016 (Stripe's own blog: 'Tonic is now RunKit, a part of Stripe'). Per the provider card, the RunKit service (notebooks/Embed/Endpoint) appears discontinued: all domains return HTTP 503 since Jan 2026 and the TLS cert expired, with no official shutdown announcement found.
